adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts `uniqueGuests` is computed with a case-sensitive check (`guest === attendee.email`) and with blacklist values lowercased but `guest` not normalized before `includes`, so differently-cased duplicates and blacklist-bypassing variants can pass the filter and be inserted via `createMany`. Also, when some inputs are filtered out (already-attending/blacklisted), the handler still succeeds and returns only `{ message: "Guests added" }` with no indication of skipped addresses (it only errors when *all* are filtered).
